title: Every ranked briefing row names the bar its distance was measured from
hypothesis: The desk's rank order is (band class, distance_bps asc, band score desc, symbol asc), but distance_bps is measured against a reference close whose session can be days older than the screen's as_of, and the recorded row keeps no trace of which bar that was -- so a fresh reading and a stale one sit on one scale, indistinguishable. Recording compute_tradability's own basis_as_of verbatim on each new screen row (plus a plain basis_age_days derivation from the snapshot's own as_of, the distance_bps precedent) and rendering it as a descriptive column on /desk makes every ranked row self-describing, and makes the append-only screen ledger genuinely evaluable by the future era goal.md's Vision 3 promises it to.
journey_sketch: J-08: record basis_as_of (read verbatim from compute_tradability) + basis_age_days on every NEW screen row, register both in the Data Contract under desk_screen.py / GET /research/desk/screen, render a descriptive basis column on /desk, and render already-recorded snapshots' rows with an honest 'basis not recorded in this snapshot' state (never backfilled).
note: Not a data-pattern survivor -- no state/pnl-scan.json snapshot exists and this era's Non-Goals forbid kind profile|strategy work outright (no new strategies/profiles, no champion movement, no PnL-ledger rows beyond existing machinery), so guidance sec.4 leaves only surface/enabling work. Per this era's own enhancement-loop anti-goal the journey therefore carries the single-source-of-truth acceptance criterion in place of a PnL-ledger append. MEASURED LIVE (curl, backend :8301, ambient store, 2026-07-27): GET /research/tradability?as_of=2026-07-25 returns basis_as_of 2026-07-24 for AAPL (age 1 d), 2026-07-23 for TSLA/JPM/AMZN/GOOGL/AMD (2 d), 2026-07-21 for MSFT (4 d) and 2026-07-13 for META/NFLX/NVDA (12 d) -- an 11-day spread; the recorded screen snapshot screen-2026-07-25-e184a7dc2f86 ranks NFLX #2 at distance_bps 0.0 with no basis field anywhere in the row (DeskScreenRow: symbol, side, band_class, distance_bps, band_score, price_low, price_high, coverage, tick_evidence). Zero new math, zero new Config field, zero diff to tradability.py/levels.py/bars.py; the value already exists as a typed canonical field (TradabilityResponse.basis_as_of, lib/types.ts:618).

title: Coverage the frozen store can prove -- an operator-reachable bar-index reconciliation
hypothesis: The desk's coverage badges read the derived bar_index (T-4, correctly), but the index only ever grows through insert() at record time: series recorded before it existed are invisible to coverage forever, and BarIndex.reindex() -- the documented, tested repair that rebuilds the index from the frozen store -- has zero call sites in app/, so no operator can reach it. An explicit operator-run reconciliation (compute-manager pattern, never a page-load GET) that reports index-vs-store drift and rebuilds the derived index through the existing reindex() would make the coverage the desk serves provably equal to what the append-only store holds, without touching a single stored series.
journey_sketch: J-xx: add a desk-owned, operator-run coverage reconciliation (POST + CLI, single-flight, cancellable) that reports per-pair index-vs-store drift through ONE new canonical endpoint with an honest 'not reconciled yet' state and repairs the derived index via the existing BarIndex.reindex(), proving every stored bar file byte-identical before and after.
note: MEASURED LIVE (2026-07-27, ambient store): GET /research/desk/coverage reports has_bars:false for 7 (member x screened-timeframe) pairs whose series the frozen BarStore actually holds -- META 1h+1d, NFLX 1h+1d, NVDA 1h+1d, MSFT 4h (369 store series vs 281 bar_index rows; the unindexed series are the legacy 09:32:06.885430Z/14:23:09Z-window recordings). grep confirms reindex() is called from tests/test_bar_index.py only, never from app/. NOT promoted this cycle: /desk already DISCLOSES the divergence honestly (desk-coverage-divergence-note, app/desk/page.tsx:271-278, 'the index holds no entry for that pair'), the ranking itself is unaffected (skip/rank decisions read the store, not the index), and one journey per cycle keeps the iteration lean -- desk-row-basis-disclosure outranks it because it corrects the meaning of the rank key the operator actually reads. Re-propose next cycle. Constraints for whoever builds it: GET must never walk the store (T-4/5C 31.4s lesson) -- serve a recorded reconciliation result or an honest absence; the frozen JSON store stays append-only and byte-identical (only the derived, loss-free index is rebuilt); no new Config field; pin 08e471b10130e1e2 unchanged.

title: Every top-up run leaves an append-only record of what it attempted
hypothesis: The desk's briefing is dominated by honest absences it cannot explain: 38 of the 101 members of the pinned universe snapshot render as `skipped: no bars` and 5 ranked rows carry a dark 1h badge, yet the ONLY place the reason ever existed -- the per-pair outcome list `run_topup` already returns, with the vendor/HTTP detail preserved verbatim -- lives in process memory (the manager, honestly lost on restart) or on stdout (the CLI). Persisting each run's own outcomes ONCE at its terminal state as a frozen, checksummed, append-only run record, served by one new canonical endpoint and rendered on /desk, makes 'attempted and failed', 'never attempted' and 'reused' distinguishable after the fact -- with zero new math, zero new Config field, and no second coverage path.
journey_sketch: J-09: write one frozen, checksummed, append-only top-up run record per run (run id, universe snapshot id, requested fetch window, config_fingerprint, terminal state, pairs_total vs pairs_attempted, and run_topup's verbatim per-pair outcome+detail) through a single shared writer both the compute manager and the CLI call; register it in the Data Contract with one owner and `GET /research/desk/topup/runs` as its only serving endpoint (honest-empty before any run); render a read-only top-up-runs section on /desk beside the screen history; add NO MCP tool (J-06's exactly-17 contract stays green -- get_endpoint already reaches the path).
